symptom: Under a synthetic no-op Array.prototype.forEach, the v230 offline candidate still skips req/dg required-value checks, admitting an empty evaluationProtocolId or a non-SHA sourceManifestDigest. The exported digest can then hash invalid records. The current PR retains the same source-level forEach helpers; no live research incident was observed.
lesson: Removing iterator, map, sort, some and includes dependencies is insufficient when required-field validators still delegate to mutable Array.prototype.forEach. Admission and direct digest must fail closed for invalid nonblank/SHA fields even under hostile ambient methods.
guardrail: Use indexed traversal for req/dg required-field validation; exercise synthetic no-op forEach with invalid required string and SHA-256 values, normal-record parity, and direct digest rejection in the canonical TypeScript test runner before integrating the patch.
